rejection_summary: Image technically valid but visually rejected for production

root_cause_analysis.primary_cause: Environment visibility and framing constraints were specified in commit 9e3ec46 but the generated output still violated these constraints
root_cause_analysis.secondary_cause: Generic portrait detector and environment visibility blocker may not have been properly enforced at generation time
root_cause_analysis.possible_workflow_issue: Prompt conditioning may not have sufficiently emphasized scene context and wider framing

corrective_actions.description: Strengthen negative prompt to explicitly forbid close-up headshots and enforce medium/wide framing
corrective_actions.implementation: Add explicit negative terms: 'close-up', 'headshot', 'face only', 'tight framing'

corrective_actions.description: Strengthen positive prompt to require visible environment/scene context
corrective_actions.implementation: Add explicit positive terms: 'character in environment', 'scene visible', 'background shows location'

corrective_actions.description: Verify environment visibility detector is active and properly blocking generations without scene context
corrective_actions.implementation: Add runtime guard that checks for plain/gradient backgrounds and rejects before submission

corrective_actions.description: Ensure canonical reference includes environment context to guide generation
corrective_actions.implementation: Review canonical reference and ensure it shows character in scene

success_criteria: Generated image shows character at medium shot or wider framing
Environment/scene background is visible and contextual
Character identity is consistent with canonical reference
Aspect ratio remains 1344x768 or approved landscape format
